## Pollination Deficit Analysis

This report was generated automatically by **pollinatorSDM**.

### Species Studied
- *Apis mellifera*
- *Bombus terrestris*

### Methodology
Species Distribution Models (SDM) were built using Random Forest to estimate pollinator distribution and pollination deficit.

### Outputs
Maps and indices were computed for agricultural decision support.
